title: Convergence of fictitious play for fully coupled FBSDEs in finite-player stochastic differential games
summary: In this article we investigate the theoretical convergence properties of the fictitious-play approximation procedure applied to coupled FBSDE systems for finite-player non-zero-sum stochastic differential games. Under one set of assumptions, the convergence is shown to be geometric. Under an additional structural assumption, the geometric convergence rate further improves to a super-exponential rate in a special class of games.
